problem: Native Word caption, envelope and AutoSummary rows had no scoped automated evidence. The matrix used stale caption/envelope API names and did not distinguish detached AutoSummary record editing from a package editor.
changes: Add seven native-parent regressions for caption template ownership/lifecycle/atomicity, Office 6/8 and opaque envelope lifecycle/protection, actual inactive native AutoSummary state and explicit priority-table derivatives.
Add a small tracked helper that compares CFB directory path/type/CLSID/state-bit/creation-time/modification-time metadata independently of sector allocation.

Correct feature-matrix API names and scope, and correct the PlcfAsumy specification reference from 2.8.4 to 2.8.9 in its source/test documentation. Runtime implementation and native fixture bytes are unchanged.

verification_scope.captions: Native layout, glossary and recorded-macro DOT parents begin without caption tables. Explicit typed labels, chapter numbering/separators, location/omit-label/format options and ProgID references survive create/update/clear. The 40-UTF-16-unit boundary succeeds; 42 units refuse. Clearing referenced labels returns the exact InvalidFormat transaction reason and leaves valid staging intact. Reopen, exact no-op, stale typed patch conflict, forward replay and whole-artifact inverse pass.
verification_scope.caption_owner_boundary: Ordinary native layout and macro DOC files have fDot=false and zero caption table lengths. The public editor refuses with its precise Normal-template-only Corrupted reason without changing the source. The specification requires zero caption lengths for fDot=0 and defines the records for the Normal template. Successful metadata publication on a native DOT derivative does not establish that host-specific role or native caption insertion.
verification_scope.envelopes: Native text DOC and macro DOT parents receive explicit Office 8 Unicode messages with recipient property bags, binary attachments, security intent flags and opaque tail bytes. Subject updates retain every other field. Invalid Office 8 contact-link removal refuses with the exact transaction error and preserves prior staging. Office 6 replacement retains uninterpreted ANSI bytes, including 0x80, and the required absent Unicode-only collections. An unknown CLSID stores exact opaque data and rejects message-only updates as an exact no-op; removal clears its FIB pair.
verification_scope.protection: The protected native DOC cannot acquire an envelope under default policy: Package(ProtectionDenied(Document)) is asserted, and committing after refusal is an exact no-op. No protection bypass is used.
verification_scope.autosummary_native: Three native DOC/DOT parents expose inactive Asumyi metadata: valid/view-active/update flags false, Highlight view and zero desired/highest/current levels. PlcfAsumy is absent with a zero length. An unchanged Dop97 parse/write retains the complete native DOP bytes.
verification_scope.autosummary_derivatives: Detached DocumentAutoSummary codecs create 0..8 level 1 and 8..16 level 3 ranges. Public CFB stream publication attaches these explicit derivatives, and Document::auto_summary reads exact values. A level replacement, invalid noncontiguous append with retained state, range removal and full clearing pass. State edits are confined to the 12-byte Asumyi span at DOP offset 414; only the priority pointer pair and appended table data may change. There is no dedicated AutoSummary package edit API.
verification_scope.preservation: Caption/envelope edits change only their FIB pairs and append selected-table ranges; original table prefixes remain exact. AutoSummary derivatives additionally own only the Asumyi span. Native document text, SEQ/glossary content, VBA and all unrelated stream bytes are retained; exact stream keys and directory metadata are checked. Every changed stage saves/reopens, replays and exactly inverts at its declared public package/CFB layer. Original package bytes and files stay unchanged.
verification_scope.limits: All caption/envelope/priority additions are library-authored derivatives. No caption insertion, field refresh, summarization, mail transport, recipient resolution, attachment activation, macro execution, native Normal-template identity, UI state application or fresh Word validation is inferred. Envelope signed/encrypted flags are metadata intent, not cryptographic proof.

specification_evidence.finding: The caption FIB pairs, CAPI, AutoCaption ProgID references and caption STTB constraints define the tested metadata. Caption lengths must be zero when fDot is zero; the Normal-template role remains a separate host condition.

specification_evidence.source: Local full specification and the tracked envelope codec/model contracts
specification_evidence.finding: The selected FIB range contains a CLSID-selected envelope with Office 6/8 versioned strings, recipient properties and attachment data. Tests keep it inert and preserve unknown CLSID/tail payloads.
Dop97 contains the Asumyi state record; PlcfAsumy contains four-byte ASUMY priorities. The source/test citation incorrectly pointed to 2.8.4 (Plcbkld) and now points to 2.8.9.

coverage.accounting: Seven new indexed tests yield 565 indexed tests and 376 partial feature rows. Three UI-limited rows gain bounded native-state/derivative operation evidence without promoting historical authoring status.
